BiblicalUsage: Pisseach means lame, unable to walk straight. Mephibosheth was lame on both his feet and still ate at the king's table in 2 Samuel 9:13, and the prophets promise the day when the lame man shall leap as a hart in Isaiah 35:6. But Malachi 1:8 rebukes priests who offer the lame as sacrifice, as if God deserved damaged goods.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God seats the lame at His table and one day makes them leap — and He will not accept leftovers as worship.
